info.title: OpenG2P Agri Stack Composite
info.description:
Agri Stack use-case Composite.

Serves approved use cases (configuration, not code) by querying several
registries over DCI with the subject's consent and returning one signed
response. No partner data is stored (the console's call log holds outcomes
and timings only).

**Use cases** (partner API): every query is a signed envelope; the detached
JWS is verified against the partner's keys in Partner Management, and the
Composite signs every response. The describe endpoints need no signature.

**Console (staff)**: read-only API for the Composite's console, behind a staff
login with the `composite:view` permission; present only when the console is on.

get.description: The published use cases: for each, the subject types and parameters it takes, the registries (sources) it queries, the consent grants and data scopes it needs, and its output fields. Configuration only; not signed and needs no signature.

One published use case, by `name` or `name@major` (or `name` with the `X-Use-Case-Major` header). Without a major version, the highest published one. Use it to build the query and the consent: `input` lists the subject types and parameters, `consent_grants_needed` and `consent_scopes` what the consent must grant. Configuration only; needs no signature.

schema.title: X-Use-Case-Major

post.description:
Serve one query for one subject. The body is a signed envelope `{signature, header, message}`: `signature` is a detached JWS over `{header, message}` made with the partner's key and verified against Partner Management (`header.sender_id`). The Composite checks that the partner's use-case policy in Partner Management grants the use case (`name@major`) and the subject's consent (`message.consent_id`, or `message.consent_jws`), queries each registry the use case names, and returns one response envelope signed with its own key.

Each source gets a status: `ok`, `no_record`, `denied`, `unavailable` or `error`. A failing optional source leaves its fields null (the response is still 200); a failing mandatory source fails the request (`source_denied`, `source_unavailable`, `source_error`).

Every answer, errors included, is a signed envelope: on an error `header.status` is `rjct` and `message.error` has the `code` and `message`.

200.description: The signed result. Optional sources that failed show in `sources`; their fields are null.

500.description: `signing_unavailable`: the Composite cannot sign; the envelope then has an empty signature.

header.status_reason_message: the composite cannot sign responses; check its signing key

error.message: the composite cannot sign responses; check its signing key

400.description: The envelope or input is not valid: `invalid_envelope`, `wrong_receiver`, `stale_request`, `invalid_use_case`, `invalid_input`, `consent_id_needs_exchange`.

header.status_reason_message: subject type must be one of ['FAYDA_FAN', 'FARMER_ID']

error.message: subject type must be one of ['FAYDA_FAN', 'FARMER_ID']

header.status_reason_message: header.message_ts is more than 300s from now

error.message: header.message_ts is more than 300s from now

401.description: `signature_invalid`: the signature does not verify against the sender's keys in Partner Management (unknown partner, unknown key or bad signature).

header.status_reason_message: the request signature does not verify against the sender's Partner Management key

error.message: the request signature does not verify against the sender's Partner Management key

403.description: Not allowed: `partner_not_allowed` (the partner's use-case policy in Partner Management does not grant this use case, `name@major`, or the partner has none), `consent_required`, `consent_malformed`, `consent_signature_invalid`, `consent_subject_mismatch`, `consent_not_yet_valid`, `consent_expired`, `consent_grant_missing`, `consent_scope_missing`, `consent_denied`, `consent_receipt_missing` (no consent token for a mandatory registry), `source_denied` (a mandatory source was denied).

header.status_reason_message: partner 'bank-b' is not granted the use case loan-profile@1 in Partner Management

error.message: partner 'bank-b' is not granted the use case loan-profile@1 in Partner Management

header.status_reason_message: the exchange Consent Manager denied the consent (consent_expired)

error.message: the exchange Consent Manager denied the consent (consent_expired)

404.description: `unknown_use_case`: no published use case with that name (and major version).

429.description: `rate_limited`: the partner went over the use case's rate.

502.description: `source_error` (a mandatory source failed) or `consent_exchange_error` (the Exchange's Consent Manager gave an answer the Composite cannot use).

503.description: `source_unavailable` (a mandatory source is down), `consent_exchange_unavailable`, or `partner_policy_unavailable` (Partner Management cannot be read to check the partner's use-case grant and no recent answer is cached).

header.status_reason_message: Partner Management cannot be read to check the partner's use-case grant; try again later

error.message: Partner Management cannot be read to check the partner's use-case grant; try again later

504.description: `source_unavailable`: a mandatory source timed out (or the use case's overall timeout was reached).

signature.description: Detached JWS (`<protected>..<signature>`) over the canonical JSON of `{header, message}` (sorted keys, no whitespace), made with the partner's key. The JWS header names the key (`kid`). The Composite verifies it against the sender's keys in Partner Management.

message_id.description: The partner's ID for this request; echoed as `meta.in_reply_to`.
message_id.title: Message Id

message_ts.description: ISO-8601 time of the request. Must be within 5 minutes of the Composite's clock.
message_ts.title: Message Ts

sender_id.description: The partner's ID in Partner Management. The signature is checked against this partner's keys.
sender_id.title: Sender Id

receiver_id.description: The Composite's partner ID. When sent, it must match.
receiver_id.title: Receiver Id

subject.description: The person the query is about.

type.description: Identifier type. One of the use case's `input.subject.id_types`, e.g. `FAYDA_FAN` (the Fayda FAN) or `FARMER_ID` (the Farmer Registry's farmer ID).
type.title: Type

subject.title: Subject

parameters.description: Use-case parameters (see `input.parameters` of the use case). Unknown names are rejected.
parameters.title: Parameters

consent_id.description: The ID of a consent the subject gave, held by the Exchange's Consent Manager. Send this or `consent_jws`, not both. Needs the Composite's Exchange consent mode.
consent_id.title: Consent Id

consent_jws.description: A consent the partner signed: a compact JWS whose claims name the subject, the purpose, a validity and one grant per registry with its data scopes. Send this or `consent_id`, not both.
consent_jws.title: Consent Jws

consent_jws.summary: Consent the partner signed (consent_jws), by farmer ID

get.description:
The Composite's settings (partner ID, consent mode, Partner Management URL, signing key ID), counts of use cases, registries and partners, and the last 24 hours of calls.

Staff only: needs a console login (IAM session cookie or `Authorization: Bearer`) with the `composite:view` permission. Present only when the console is on (`console_enabled` and a database).

get.description:
The call log, newest first: use case, partner, HTTP status, outcome, reason, duration and per-source statuses. No request or response data is stored. `total` stops at 10000 (`total_capped` is then true). `partners`: the partner IDs in the log (for filtering).

Staff only: needs a console login (IAM session cookie or `Authorization: Bearer`) with the `composite:view` permission. Present only when the console is on (`console_enabled` and a database).

data.description: The use case's output fields. A field built from a failed source is null; an empty list or 0 means the registry has nothing.

status.title: Status
status.description: `ok`: records found. `no_record`: the registry has none for the subject. `denied`: the registry or the consent refused (or the consent does not grant the source's scopes). `unavailable`: timeout, HTTP 5xx/408/429, or not reachable. `error`: any other failure.

type.title: Type
type.description: Identifier type. One of the use case's `input.subject.id_types`, e.g. `FAYDA_FAN` (the Fayda FAN) or `FARMER_ID` (the Farmer Registry's farmer ID).

Subject.title: Subject

consent.title: Consent

consent_grants_needed.title: Consent Grants Needed
consent_grants_needed.description: Registries the consent must have a grant for.

consent_scopes.title: Consent Scopes
consent_scopes.description: Per registry, the data scopes the consent's grant must (`required`) and may (`optional`) name.

output_fields.title: Output Fields
output_fields.description: Fields of the response's `data`, as dotted paths.

source_status.title: Source Status

partial_response.title: Partial Response
partial_response.description: `allowed`: a failing optional source still gives a 200; `denied`: any failing source fails the request.
